title: Average Height of Buildings in Each Segment
notes:
## Intuition

The average can only change where some building starts or ends. Between two neighbouring endpoints the set of covering buildings is fixed, so the street splits into a few elementary pieces. Averaging each piece by scanning all buildings is O(n²); a sweep line instead keeps the running `count` and height `total` of the buildings currently covering the street, updated at every start (+) and end (−) event.

## Approach

1. Turn each building into two events: `[start, 1, height]` and `[end, -1, -height]`. Sort them by position.
2. Sweep with `count`, `total` and `prev`, the position of the previous event.
3. At each event, the piece `[prev, position)` has just been passed with the old `count` and `total`. If it is non-empty and covered, its `average` is `Math.floor(total / count)`.
4. If the `last` segment in `street` ends exactly at `prev` with the same average, stretch it to `position`; otherwise push `[prev, position, average]`.
5. Apply the event's `delta` and `change`, then move `prev` to `position`.

## Example 1, step by step

Events in order: `1:+2`, `3:+4`, `4:-2`, `9:-4`. At `3`, the piece `[1, 3)` has one building of total 2, so push `[1, 3, 2]`. At `4`, `[3, 4)` has two buildings totalling 6, average 3, which differs from 2, so push `[3, 4, 3]`. At `9`, `[4, 9)` has one building of height 4: push `[4, 9, 4]`. Result: `[[1,3,2],[3,4,3],[4,9,4]]`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n log n) to sort the 2n events; the sweep is linear.
- Space: O(n) for the events and the answer.

## Pitfalls

- Only merge segments that truly touch (`last[1] === prev`); a gap with no buildings must break the run, as in Example 3.
- Use integer division: `[0,4,1]` and `[1,3,2]` give averages 1, 1, 1 and collapse into a single segment.
- Several events can share a position; record the piece before any of them is applied, and skip empty pieces (`position > prev`).
- Skip pieces with `count === 0` to avoid dividing by zero.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `events` | `[position, delta, change]` for every start and end |
| `count` | buildings covering the street just before `position` |
| `total` | sum of their heights |
| `prev` | position of the previous event |
| `average` | rounded-down average height on `[prev, position)` |
| `last` | the most recent segment in `street` |
| `street` | the answer segments |
